name: deploy-docs-preview-kbdev
title: Deploy documentation preview to kooboo-kbdev
description: Deploy the verified preview service to 192.168.10.75 on port 4173 using a dedicated non-root account without changing Kooboo.Web or ports 80/443.
creator: wg
notes: Deployed the current kb-docs worktree to 192.168.10.75:4173 with the dedicated kb-docs-preview account, immutable releases, and an enabled systemd service. Nginx was intentionally skipped because Kooboo.Web continues to own ports 80/443. Fixed the production-only nested pnpm launch failure by using corepack pnpm, added installer health retries for the Type=simple startup race, and report sourceDirty as null when Git metadata is intentionally absent. Verified service active/enabled, status ready, root and /cms/ HTTP 200 from both the server and the local LAN client, and Kooboo.Web remained active. Release: 20260811T030456Z-unknown-3.
